The explicit absolutely convergent eigen-energy V_p(x)=sum_{k>=0}q^k lambda^{-(k+1)}|ell^T A^k x|^p is continuous, p-homogeneous, strictly positive for x!=0 because ell^T and ell^T D are independent when gamma!=0. The defining F_p(lambda)=1 gives exact qV_p(Ax)+(1-q)V_p(Nx)=lambda V_p(x); compactness on unit circle bounds it above/below by Euclidean norm^p, proving all times and initial states, not just renewal times. Two consecutive N steps cause finite absorption a.s. For canonical A=[[2,-1],[1,0]], N=[[0,0],[1,0]], gamma=-1, independent exact multiplication verifies q=1/3 invariant Q=[[6,-3],[-3,2]] positive definite, q1=1/2, q2=1/3 and q=.4 rates 0.889897948557 and 1.113507624413. Geometric K_q stochastic ordering yields unique q_p for all p>0; strict decrease with p is only asserted for |gamma|=1 example.
